verdict.rationale: Exporting workspace message history is a fair question for a chat platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no admin-facing export of server message history in machine-readable formats, and nothing on including private threads or DMs under policy. The REST API, Gateway and bots are developer building blocks that could be used to construct such an export, not the export capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can export the full message history of my workspace in machine-readable formats, including private conversations where policy allows
